notes.title: Planned updates
notes.content:
Welcome to early access of OP. After-Mass N1!

Here are more information you need to know:
--Regular updates are scheduled with 2 Hot fixes and 1 major expansion each 1 month.
--with hot fixes, I'll be focus mainly on stability issue/ bug fix and optimization work.
--With the major expansion,  there will be a bran-new technique introduced into the game, and with expansion of the map.


Features that I wish to include but doesn't have a plan yet due to shortage of time and hands.
--An exclusive Single player campaign with detailed story. 
--Large scale fight with more than fifty player. (25v25, battle royale etc..)


Please be noted, I will do anything in my power to make this game good!



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515760/OP_AfterMass_N1/
